FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c

WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL

WITH eligible_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.amount_minor,

    FROM orders o

    WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.is_internal = FALSE
      AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
      AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
      AND o.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
      AND o.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01'
),
refund_totals AS (
    SELECT
        r.order_id,
        SUM(r.amount_minor) AS refund_amount_minor
    FROM refunds r
    JOIN eligible_orders eo
      ON eo.order_id = r.order_id
    GROUP BY r.order_id
)
SELECT
    SUM(
        (
            eo.amount_minor
            - COALESCE(rt.refund_amount_minor, 0)
        )
        * CASE eo.currency
            WHEN 'EUR' THEN 0.0108
            WHEN 'JPY' THEN 0.0067
            WHEN 'USD' THEN 0.01
          END
    ) AS net_revenue_usd
FROM eligible_orders eo
LEFT JOIN refund_totals rt
  ON rt.order_id = eo.order_id;

SELECT
    p.product_id,
    p.category,
    SUM(oi.qty) AS units_sold
FROM order_items AS oi
JOIN products AS p
    ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN orders AS o
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN customers AS c
    ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE p.category = 'apparel'
  AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
  AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.is_internal = FALSE
GROUP BY
    p.product_id,
    p.category
ORDER BY
    units_sold DESC,
    p.product_id
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
    SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price_minor * CASE o.currency
        WHEN 'EUR' THEN 0.0108
        WHEN 'JPY' THEN 0.0067
    END) AS gross_revenue_usd
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c
    ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items AS oi
    ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products AS p
    ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.is_internal = FALSE
  AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
  AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
  AND p.category = 'apparel';

WITH eligible_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, o.currency
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c
      ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.is_internal = FALSE
      AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
      AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
),
currency_factors AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (VALUES
        ('EUR', 0.0108::DECIMAL),
        ('JPY', 0.0067::DECIMAL)
    ) AS t(currency, usd_factor)
)
SELECT COALESCE(
           SUM(
               oi.qty
               * oi.unit_price_minor
               * cf.usd_factor
           ),
           0
       ) AS gross_revenue_usd
FROM order_items oi
JOIN eligible_orders eo
  ON eo.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p
  ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN currency_factors cf
  ON cf.currency = eo.currency
